detail.longDescription: Sorry if my description is hard to understand. I have two branches of a project and need to compare them. I want to get a broad overview, so I initially tried the following: source control->graph->right click commit in branch1->dropdown menu appears->compare with...->dropdown menu appears at top->select branch2: wait after waiting, the multi diffing tab finishes loading with all the added, changed, deleted, removed or renamed files. However, what if i want to remove all the removed files from the output? I don't see a way to do that here. So I thought, maybe there's a way to pass in a list of files from git diff with options, to vscode myself, if the UI method is too limited? but I don't know. I'm not currently using a extension atm. I know gitlens exists but that costs $72/yr. and I don't know if it would do what I'm asking anyway, which is to programatically pass a list of changed files i want to vscode to diff all at once (maybe from a specific directory, excluding files starting with the character _, and not including deleted files, just as an example).
